title: Boost Business Central Development with Skills in Visual Studio Code
summary: Skills in Visual Studio Code enable developers to create advanced, repeatable prompts for Business Central AL development. The post explains how to install and manage skills using a .github folder, and recommends existing skill libraries like the AL Development Collection to accelerate Copilot-assisted development.
key_points: Skills in development environments work like Copilot Cowork skills, automating repeatable development processes with advanced prompts
Skills require a .github folder to manage, located alongside .alpackages, .codeAnalysis, and .vscode folders
The AL Development Collection extension provides a comprehensive library including skills, agents, tools, docs, and prompts for Business Central development
Multiple skill libraries exist that developers can install to enhance their Copilot AI-assisted development workflow
